component.name: IndexItem
component.script:
' Prints every itemContent and index change with a per-instance serial, so recycling shows up as one serial ' getting a new content (and, if the device keeps it in step, a new index). sub init() m.serial = m.global.serial + 1 m.global.serial = m.serial end sub
sub onContent() c = m.top.itemContent title = "invalid" if c <> invalid title = c.title m.top.findNode("title").text = c.title end if print "PROBE|item|" + m.global.probeCase + "|content|serial=" + m.serial.toStr() + " content=" + title + " index=" + m.top.index.toStr() + " rowIndex=" + m.top.rowIndex.toStr() end sub
sub onIndex() print "PROBE|item|" + m.global.probeCase + "|index|serial=" + m.serial.toStr() + " index=" + m.top.index.toStr() end sub
sub onSize() fill = m.top.findNode("fill") fill.width = m.top.width fill.height = m.top.height title = m.top.findNode("title") title.width = m.top.width title.height = m.top.height end sub
